sweeps.name: admission-batched-tokens
sweeps.narrative: Throughput should rise with the cap and flatten above 16384, leaving the 8192 default short of optimal on this traffic.

sweeps.name: admission-prefill-chunking
sweeps.narrative: Chunking should HURT throughput here, so the uncapped default wins and this sweep prices the interactivity it would buy.

sweeps.name: drafting
sweeps.narrative: dspark drafting should pay on this decode-bound replay, with the gain growing toward the graph's declared num_spec_tokens of 5.

sweeps.name: routing-and-prefix-cache
sweeps.narrative: prefix-affinity with caching on should win and random with caching off should be the floor; the gap is the value of prefix reuse.
